ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white occupies approximately 65% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black pigmentation covering approximately 35%, primarily concentrated along the perimeter and in scattered internal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation forms the core of both lobes. Thick, irregular black bands define the trailing edges. Numerous small black focal spots and streaks are distributed throughout the white field. A notable solitary dark circular blob is located in the mid-inner region of the right lobe (viewer's perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes, exhibiting deep penetration toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography. The left lobe (viewer's perspective) displays a relatively continuous serrated edge with small-amplitude variations. The right lobe displays high-amplitude irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys (tears) particularly in the mid-section of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-curving points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization are densely packed on the outer leading edge of both the left and right tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous low-intensity (dark) linear disruptions oriented vertically and diagonally across the white ventral surface of both lobes, resembling rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating physical trauma or predation marks.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, highly localized circular dark pigmentation spot located in the center-right of the right lobe's white field.
